fallback.title: Fallback Rules
fallback.description: Choose providers and only their available models. Provider model lists are cached for 15 minutes and refreshed on demand.
fallback.format: Format: JSON5 (supports // single-line and /* multi-line */ comments)
fallback.empty: No fallback rules yet. Add the first gateway model rule to begin.

embeddings.title: Embeddings Routes
embeddings.empty: No embedding routes yet. Add the first embedding model to begin.

rerank.title: Rerank Routes
rerank.empty: No rerank routes yet. Add the first rerank model to begin.

fusion.title: Fusion Models
fusion.description: Each Fusion model runs a panel of models in parallel, a judge produces a structured analysis, and a main model writes the final answer.
fusion.hint: Pick a provider and model for each role. Register the gateway itself as a provider to reuse gateway models. Panel size: 1–8.
fusion.empty: No fusion models yet. Add the first fusion model to begin.
fusion.reserveHeading: Reserve models (fill a failed panel slot)
fusion.reserveHint: Used only when a panel model errors or times out; each reserve model is tried at most once, in listed order.

router.title: Router Models
router.description: Each Router model calls a selector gateway model, then routes the original request to one explicit target.
router.hint: Selector and targets come from chat models configured in Fallback Rules. A target can use the full fallback chain or start at a specific entry.
router.empty: No router models yet. Add the first router model to begin.

imageGeneration.title: Image Generation Routes
imageGeneration.hint: The default is OpenAI-compatible passthrough. Advanced options support mapping-based adapters such as NVIDIA JSON/artifacts routes.
imageGeneration.empty: No image generation routes yet. Add the first image generation model to begin.

imageEdit.title: Image Edit Routes
imageEdit.description: Configure routes for /v1/images/edits. Supports JSON and multipart requests.
imageEdit.hint: Use request and response mappings when a downstream model requires a provider-specific shape.
imageEdit.empty: No image edit routes yet. Add the first image edit model to begin.

audioSpeech.title: Audio Speech Routes
audioSpeech.description: Configure routes for /v1/audio/speech and the voice catalog used by /v1/audio/voices.
audioSpeech.hint: Text-to-speech uses the first route for each gateway model. Retry settings and the voice catalog path are in advanced options.
audioSpeech.empty: No audio speech routes yet. Add the first speech model to begin.

audioTranscriptions.title: Audio Transcriptions Routes
audioTranscriptions.hint: Requests remain OpenAI-compatible multipart/form-data. Advanced options can select vendor adapters such as NVIDIA Riva gRPC.
audioTranscriptions.empty: No audio transcription routes yet. Add the first audio model to begin.

providers.description: Configure provider base URLs, API key references, native API type, proxy, and optional model metadata.
providers.hintBefore: API key and proxy environment variables must use explicit

modelRules.hint: Format: JSON5 object. Unknown alias targets and invalid pools fail closed on save.

fields.maxToolCalls: Max tool calls per panel model

toggles.toolCallRescue: Rescue inline tool-call text into structured calls
toggles.contextOverflowEnable: Enable dedicated fallback for context overflow errors

hints.contextOverflow: Used only when the provider reports that the current model ran out of context window.
hints.cost: Saved accounting policy: empty selects 0.1 USD. Endpoint billing remains unchanged until the durable accounting cutover.
hints.routerGatewayTarget: Use the selected gateway model with its full fallback chain.
hints.routerFallbackGateway: Choose which gateway fallback chain to start inside.
hints.routerFallbackEntry: The selected entry is tried first, then the remaining fallback entries are tried in order.
hints.routerSelector: Gateway chat model that decides which configured target should handle the request.
hints.webQueryModel: Gateway chat LLM used to expand the user query into multiple search queries. Leave empty to skip.
hints.webSearchModel: Pick one of the Web Search services configured above.
hints.webReadModel: Pick one of the Web Read services configured above.
hints.webRerankModel: Gateway rerank model used to order search results before reading articles.
hints.webAnalysisModel: Chat LLM from Fallback Rules that composes the final answer.
hints.webFastModel: Used for short, inexpensive calls such as query planning and summaries.
hints.webSmartModel: Used for report writing and quality-sensitive steps.
hints.webStrategicModel: Used for high-level planning; it can be the same as Smart LLM.
hints.webEmbeddingModel: Optional; used only by GPT Researcher vector stores.
hints.webImageModel: Gateway image model used when image generation is enabled.
hints.webImageSize: Passed through to the images endpoint as WIDTHxHEIGHT.
hints.providerMetadata: Other provider-specific metadata. Upstream limits are managed above and merged on save.
hints.providerAvailableModels: One model id per line; commas also work. If set, the gateway uses this list instead of the provider models endpoint.
hints.providerRouting: Leave empty for default round-robin without session affinity. Session affinity requires an explicit request header such as X-Session-Id.
hints.providerKeyPools: Fallback rows can reference a named upstream key pool. Raw secrets are neither shown nor generated by the UI.

tooltips.providerName: Unique provider id used in fallback rules and routes. It must be unique across the provider configuration.
tooltips.baseUrl: Upstream API root URL. It must start with http:// or https://.
tooltips.apiKey: Upstream credential. Reference an environment variable with the documented variable syntax; multiple keys can be comma-separated for rotation.
tooltips.apiType: API dialect. OpenAI uses compatible chat completions and Bearer auth; Anthropic uses native messages and Anthropic headers.
tooltips.proxy: Optional outbound proxy. Reference a proxy environment variable or enter an HTTP(S) URL. Leave empty for a direct connection.
tooltips.modelsMetadata: Free-form per-model metadata stored in the provider configuration. Upstream limits are managed separately and merged on save.
tooltips.availableModels: Optional explicit model-id list. When set, the gateway uses it instead of querying the provider models endpoint.
tooltips.routing: Optional upstream-key routing policy with round-robin, fill-first, or priority strategy and opt-in session affinity.
tooltips.upstreamKeyPools: Optional named upstream-key pools with strategy, session affinity, key ids, priorities, and enabled flags.
tooltips.upstreamLimits: Per-model upstream quota ledger, separate from client virtual-key limits. The gateway skips keys that would exceed these caps.
tooltips.modelId: Upstream model id exactly as the provider expects it.
tooltips.rpm: Requests per minute allowed per upstream key. Leave empty to disable this cap.
tooltips.rpd: Requests per day allowed per upstream key. Leave empty to disable this cap.
tooltips.tpm: Prompt and completion tokens per minute allowed per upstream key. Leave empty to disable this cap.
tooltips.tpd: Prompt and completion tokens per day allowed per upstream key. Leave empty to disable this cap.

messages.noUpstreamLimits: No upstream limits configured. Add a model to set per-key rpm/rpd/tpm/tpd.
